verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm SigNoz serves a live llms.txt at signoz.io/llms.txt and Markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /docs/introduction/.md). SigNoz also publishes a skill.md and Agent Skills that let AI assistants search and explore its docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing llms.txt scope and usage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or a guide for pointing agents at it), and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: SigNoz publishes Agent Skills that teach AI coding assistants to work with SigNoz: search the docs
